endOfMonth()
Perform searches based on the end of the current month.
See also endOfDay(), endOfWeek(), endOfYear(), startOfDay(), startOfWeek(), startOfMonth(), and startOfYear().
| Syntax | endOfMonth() where inc is an optional increment of(+/-)nn(y\|M\|w\|d\|h\|m) . If the time unit qualifier is omitted, it defaults to the natural period of the function, e.g.endOfMonth("+1") is the same asendOfMonth("+1M") . If the plus/minus(+/-) sign is omitted, plus(+) is assumed. |
